name: growably-contact-enricher
description: Enrich Growably (GoHighLevel) contacts with Apollo.io, Brave Search and website data, plus AI pre-meeting briefs. Runs on Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.check: for f in src/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && wrangler deploy --dry-run

CONFIG_KEY.description: Any long random string, 32 or more characters. A password manager's generator is fine. It encrypts the API keys the app stores. Keep a copy somewhere safe.

ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Leave as-is for now. After deploying you will set up Cloudflare Access and come back to fill this in (SETUP.md step 3).

ACCESS_APP_AUD.description: Leave as-is for now. Filled in after Cloudflare Access is set up (SETUP.md step 3).
